comment: Fixed-latency dependency table of cubit's opt-in dependency-aware stall model (CUBIT_SCHED2_LAT). L = minimum issue distance in stall units (sum of the stall counts from the producer to the consumer on every control-flow path) between a producer WITHOUT a write barrier and a consumer reading its result in the given operand role. role: r<k> / a<k> = register / address-base operand at position k among the non-predicate operands (destination = 0), u<k> = uniform register, p = predicate operand, g = guard, gc = guard of a control-flow instruction, * = any role; a trailing h = a register above the named one of a multi-register operand (the high half of a 64-bit addend / address: read later than the low half). `result_high`: a reader of an UPPER register of a multi-register result of the producers named there (the high half of a 64-bit product is ready later than its low half) takes the larger of the pair's cell and the cell of `result_high.cells` for it; where the census has no dense cell for the upper register it takes the pair's cell, but never less than `result_high.floor`. `producer_forms`: the result of a producer FORM named there -- the class plus the modifiers the form does not carry (`CS2R` without `.32` = the 64-bit form, a register pair) -- is never read closer than the entry's L in any register or address role: the larger of L and the pair's cell or default; the (consumer, role) pairs of `except` keep their cell or default (a trailing h of the role is ignored).

provenance.dense_cell: >= 50 pairs, >= 8 at the minimum, minimum <= 7 (guards <= 15); every other pair takes a default

VOID in this run and not listed under `cells`: imad_sts_a (IMAD -> STS address) -- its read-back summed the slot's four words and cannot see a store that always lands one word late; re-measured with a position-weighted read-back in the store_addr file

stall-floor harness v5c, the store-address pairs with a position-weighted read-back (the store's slot is read back as w0 + 3*w1 + 5*w2 + 7*w3, so a store that lands one word off changes the checksum), sm_120 test host GPU 0, 2026-11-10: IADD3 / IMAD -> the address register of STS; distance 0..2 x stall 1..8, 32 CTAs x 1 024 threads x 256 iterations x 20 launches, S15 reference per pair. Clean from S01 at every distance: a store reads its address when the memory pipe serves it, not at issue (the store-latch files)

The floors are those of the plain forms of the class (F2FP.UNPACK -> HMUL2 5, F2FP.PACK -> STS 3 / the last register 1, SEL -> F2FP.UNPACK 5, SHF -> 4, MOV -> 5): no cell or default of the table is below one of them
